page: Amazon Web Services dl1.24xlarge is a specialized GPU-accelerated instance designed for deep learning workloads. It features 96 vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8275CL processors running at 3.0 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 768.0 GB of DDR4 memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per physical core. For hardware acceleration, it integrates eight Habana Gaudi HL-205 GPUs with a total of 256 GB of VRAM.

Storage and networking capabilities include 4000 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 100 Gbps. The underlying Nitro hypervisor manages resource allocation. In benchmark testing, the instance demonstrates strong multi-core CPU performance, scoring 94566.82 on stress-ng multi-core and 62653.45 on the Passmark CPU test. Memory bandwidth is also strong, reaching 5249.26 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 221.29 GB/sec for large uncached blocks.

Single-core performance is moderate, with a Geekbench single-core score of 1385.0 and an average stress-ng single-core score of 1569.1. However, the instance excels in parallelized tasks, showing strong results in software compilation and database operations. Qualitative cost efficiency is driven by the high density of specialized Habana Gaudi accelerators combined with substantial local NVMe storage, making it suitable for large-scale deep learning training, multi-threaded data processing, and database operations.
description: Amazon Web Services dl1.24xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance designed for deep learning and parallel computing workloads. Powered by 96 vCPUs from Intel Xeon 8275CL processors at 3.0 GHz, it features 768.0 GB of DDR4 memory and eight Habana Gaudi HL-205 GPUs providing 256 GB of total VRAM. Storage is supported by 4000 GB of local NVMe SSDs, and networking delivers a 100 Gbps baseline. Benchmarks indicate strong multi-core CPU performance, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 94566.82, and strong memory bandwidth of up to 5249.26 GB/sec. While single-core performance is average, the instance delivers strong results in database operations and software compilation. This hardware profile is optimized for deep learning training, multi-threaded data processing, and high-throughput database workloads.
